purpose: Speech/TTS offline asset selection for stage 3 preparation before the next GPU window.
scope_guardrails: Do not use paid APIs or non-commercial voice-cloning models.
Do not load PyTorch checkpoints with unsafe pickle paths; ONNX assets are preferred for canaries.
Do not treat derivative hosting licenses as washing original Common Voice consent or use conditions.
Do not claim Common Voice audio bytes are staged until the official API-key and terms flow is completed.

recommendation.common_voice_source: Mozilla Data Collective Common Voice Spontaneous Speech 5.0 - English
